prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single objectively “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case — the right lawyer depends on the details of your crash, injuries, insurance issues, and which lawyer is the best fit for you. I can help you find strong candidates, but here’s a practical way to identify the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for your situation.

What to look for
- Relevant experience: handles car-accident cases regularly (not a generalist) and has experience with cases like yours (catastrophic injury, wrongful death, commercial vehicle, uninsured motorist, etc.).
- Trial experience and results: willingness and experience to take a case to trial if insurers don’t offer a fair settlement.
- Credentials: board certification in personal injury trial law (Texas Board of Legal Specialization) is a strong plus. Recognition from groups like Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell AV ratings, Million Dollar Advocates can also be helpful.
- Contingency-fee practice: most PI lawyers work on contingency (no fee unless you recover).
- Good client reviews and local reputation.
- Clear communication: you should know who will handle the file day-to-day and how you’ll be updated.

Where to find reputable lawyers
- Texas Bar Association and Houston Bar Association lawyer referral services.
- Texas Board of Legal Specialization to check board certification.
- Super Lawyers, Martindale-Hubbell, and Million Dollar Advocates membership lists.
- Google/Yelp/Avvo reviews and Better Business Bureau.
- Recommendations from people you trust who had similar cases.

Questions to ask in a free consultation
- How many car-accident cases have you handled, and what percent of your practice is car wrecks?
- Have you tried similar cases to verdict? What were the outcomes?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day?
- What is your fee structure and any expected costs out of pocket?
- How will you handle medical liens and dealing with insurers?
- What strategy would you use for my case and a rough timeline?
- Can you provide references from recent clients (if available)?

Practical next steps
1. Narrow to 3–5 lawyers/firms and schedule free consultations.
2. Bring police report, photos, medical records, insurance info, and any correspondence.
3. Compare answers on experience, approach, estimated value, and communication style — pick the lawyer you trust and who shows they’ll be aggressive if needed.

If you want, tell me your Houston ZIP code, brief facts about the crash (severity, injuries, commercial vehicle involvement, uninsured motorist, death), and whether you prefer a boutique trial firm or a large firm — I can then suggest specific well-regarded firms or types of attorneys to contact and a short list of questions tailored to your case.
